tools.name: registries_fdic-bank-lookup
tools.description: Find a US FDIC-insured or formerly insured institution by certificate number, RSSD id, or name in the vendored FDIC BankFind institutions file. Returns status, charter class, and end date; ambiguous names return candidates. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/registries/fdic-bank-lookup. An unpaid call r

tools.name: registries_ncua-credit-union-lookup
tools.description: Find a US credit union by NCUA charter number, RSSD id, name, or trade name from the vendored NCUA 5300 Call Report FOICU and TradeNames files. Only credit unions that filed in that cycle are listed. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/registries/ncua-credit-union-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402

tools.name: registries_uk-charity-lookup
tools.description: Find a charity on the Charity Commission register for England and Wales by registered number or name from a vendored charity-level subset of the register extract. Removed charities are reported, not missed. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/registries/uk-charity-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402
